proposals.evidence: DEDR 5024 directly gives Tamil/Malayalam mūkku, Kota mūk, Kodagu mūkï, Kurukh muĩ and Parji muvāḍ nose. Source annotations identify this article. Badaga, Betta Kurumba and Ravula mūkə/mūkkə are comparative extensions to lects not listed there; no exact DEDR attestation is claimed for them. Parji nasal-vowel spelling muvãḍ is preserved. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR5259 documents Malayalam vayaṟu and Toda pīṟ belly, along with Tamil vayiṟu and the wider vac-Vṯ family. Survey vayarə and pir correspond directly. Ravula bairu/bārə are comparative extensions labelled look-alikes in the source; their initial voicing and contraction remain visible for review. The number474 in the annotation is the page, not the two numeral article. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Betta Kurumba and Ravula kālə are explicitly comparative extensions, labelled look-alikes in the upstream source, not literal DEDR attestations. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
